svg.text: One mechanism, five consequences, one boundary
MECHANISM — 4 access-control edge types produce one detection signature
under the stated telemetry baseline, so 79.4% of walkable edges carry a single derived cost,
leaving no gradient for a cost-aware planner to climb.
Both planners return the same route at the same cost
Hop counts identical on all three entry points
Cost moves, route does not - and still does not at k = 10
BOUNDARY — DISCRIMINATION SURVIVES OUTSIDE THE COLLAPSED CLASS
Sensitivity is set by a minority-class edge
Threshold is GenericWrite, not DCSync - the collapsed value
ACL edge inside the majority: nothing. Membership edge outside it: moves

Rows 1 and 2 carry no value: they report absences, and a figure cannot show an absence with a number. Majority rows are solid-marked, boundary rows open-marked and hatched - no information is carried by hue.
